title: PPGFlowECG: Latent Rectified Flow with Cross-Modal Encoding for PPG-Guided ECG Generation and Cardiovascular Disease Detection
abstract: arXiv:2509.19774v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electrocardiography (ECG) is the clinical gold standard for cardiovascular disease (CVD) assessment, yet continuous monitoring is constrained by the need for dedicated hardware and trained personnel. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is ubiquitous in wearable devices and readily scalable, but it lacks electrophysiological specificity, limiting diagnostic reliability. While generative methods aim to translate PPG into clinically useful ECG signals, existing approaches are limited by the misalignment of physiological semantics in generative models and the complexity of modeling in high-dimensional signals. translated_title: PPGFlowECG：基于跨模态编码的潜在整流流，用于PPG引导的心电图生成与心血管疾病检测
translated_abstract: 心电图（ECG）是心血管疾病（CVD）评估的临床金标准，但连续监测受限于对专用硬件和受过训练人员的依赖。光电容积脉搏波描记法（PPG）在可穿戴设备中无处不在且易于规模化，但其缺乏电生理特异性，限制了诊断的可靠性。尽管生成式方法旨在将PPG转化为临床可用的ECG信号，但现有方法受限于生成模型中生理语义的不对齐以及高维信号建模的复杂性。为解决这些局限，我们提出了PPGFlowECG，这是一个两阶段框架，首先使用CardioAlign编码器在共享潜在空间中对齐PPG和ECG，然后通过潜在整流流合成ECG。我们进一步对这种耦合提供了形式化分析，表明CardioAlign编码器对于保证稳定和……是必要的（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出两阶段框架PPGFlowECG，利用CardioAlign编码器在共享潜在空间中对齐PPG与ECG，并通过潜在整流流从可穿戴设备的PPG信号生成临床可用心电图，用于心血管疾病检测。
en_tdlr: PPGFlowECG is a two-stage framework that aligns PPG and ECG in a shared latent space via the CardioAlign Encoder and uses latent rectified flow to synthesize clinically useful ECG from wearable PPG signals for cardiovascular disease detection.
